scientific_integrity: Finite checks are corroborative; the complete prime-power theorem is justified by a companion-matrix argument, residue-field spectral exponents, an exact nonsquare derivative, and a square-parameter Jordan witness. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime powers and unit parameters only. Function-value periods, not coefficientwise polynomial periods; prior finite-field period work is acknowledged, and historical novelty remains subject to further specialist review.
title: Exact prime-power lifts of common index periods for second-kind Dickson functions
